nom: Philosophy Purity Made Simple Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: many, including some with dry-sensitive or oily-sensitive skin, report no irritation, tightness, or breakouts, but a comparable number describe the foam as too strong, leaving skin feeling stripped, dry, tight, or reactive, and one reviewer's rosacea flared up.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with dry, sensitive, and menopausal skin, report the foam is gentler than expected and does not leave skin feeling tight or stripped.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one with very oily and sensitive skin, report the cleanser controls oil and reduces breakouts without over-drying.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one with sensitive combination skin, mostly report a good balance between cleaning oily areas and not over-drying dry patches, though one found the formula too strong for her sensitive combination skin.

concerns.dehydration: Whether the foam leaves skin dry or hydrated divides reviewers: many, including some with dry or sensitive skin, report no tightness or stripped feeling, while a comparable number describe dryness, tightness, or a stripped feeling, especially with frequent use.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report the cleanser did not trigger redness even on sensitive skin, while one reviewer's rosacea flared up after use, though her husband without rosacea had no issues.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer blackheads, smaller pores, or reduced breakouts with regular use, including one whose acne-prone son saw a significant improvement; a few instead report the product caused a breakout or did not reduce their usual acne.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser removes excess oil and leaves skin feeling less oily over time, without stripping it dry.

aspects.libelle: One pump dispenses more than needed
Mild herbal or citrus scent divides opinion
Does not fully remove eye makeup
Good value, a little goes a long way

extraits.texte: This was a foamy cleanser , there was no scent to it. But unfortunately it did break me out might be too strong for sensitive skin. The other product itself was easy to use . The packaging was nice as well just wish it hadn't broken me out . On the other hand my face felt clean after I used it . So I think it's worth trying it if u don't have super sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Nice cleanser- just make sure it's for your skin type!
extraits.texte: This is a nice cleanser especially for the price ($29). It's a decent size (5 oz), and you don't need much product (maybe half a pump) for your whole face. I like the fact that it's a foam. Some other cleansers require you to add water to get it to foam, and they don't always lather well. No problem here! The cleanser has great ingredients for pore cleansing like glycolic acid and papaya enzyme. However, it's just too strong for my sensitive combo skin. My face feels tight and reactive after using although it definitely feels clean! If you have oily skin and don't react to ingredients, you'll love this. It gets the job done! Even though this product isn't a good fit for my specific skin type, this left a good impression on me, and I'm going to check out other products by this brand.

extraits.titre: A family favorite! Amazing for mature skin and my son's a...
extraits.texte: As a longtime fan of Philosophy's original creamy Purity cleanser, I was thrilled to test out this new Pore Purifying Foam. I have dry, sensitive, maturing, and menopausal skin, so I am usually very careful with foaming cleansers. I used this a few times a week to get the exfoliating benefits of the glycolic acid. To my surprise, it didn't leave my skin feeling tight or stripped! The foam is incredibly thick, lathers beautifully, and a little goes a long way. It left my skin feeling completely cleaned with absolutely zero irritation. While I still prefer the original creamy emulsion for my dry skin type, this foam found a permanent home with my son. He has larger pores, blackheads, and textured skin. Since he started using it, his skin has improved significantly. His blackheads and breakouts are visibly reduced, and it doesn't dry him out. We both love that the scent is very minimal and quickly dissipates after rinsing. I will definitely continue buying this for him!

extraits.titre: My skin has never looked better
extraits.texte: This foaming cleanser is actually very good. It's super effective. It's really hard for me to find a cleanser that doesn't cause my skin to break out so far I've only been successful with the pink grapefruit Neutrogena, but this is on a complete other level. My skin has never been more clear, even toned, skin tighter, or pores smaller. It feels luxurious and airy and smell. Smells like a spa day. Such a good cleanser I'm very happy with it. I have combination oily skin with some dry patches on my chin, and they have gotten worse using my other cleanser when I made the switch to this within three days the red marks on either side of my chin all but disappeared. This will be my new cleanser now. ￼

I'm absolutely in love with the scent of this cleanser. It has a very comforting, herbal aroma derived from natural essential oil. The self foaming pump texture is incredibly convenient, just one pump gives a rich foam, so I just need to massage it on and rinse. I have very sensitive oily skin, so I am very picky with cleansers, but this Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser formula works wonders. If effectively controls excess sebum without drying me out, leaving my face felling deep clean, smooth, and fresh. Most importantly, it causes absolutely zero irritation or redness. It rinses off completely clean with zero sticky or greasy residue left behind, my skin look healthier. Highly recommended!

I received the philosophy Pore Purifying Foam Cleaner for Free in exchange for my honest opinion. I have been using this pore foam cleanser for about two weeks now. I actually really like it! Just the right amount comes out with each pump and you only need one or two pumps for each use. The foam is very lightweight and easily washes into your skin. There is not really any scent but it does leave your face feeling refreshed and clean. I highly recommend the philosophy Pore Purifying Foam Cleanser.

I am giving this a 5 star only because my husband loved it. I have Rosacea and it flared my skin up. However, my husband who does not have sensitive skin, it worked out great for him. He also has oily skin. He told me that his face felt so clean and not dry at all. He even noticed that it wasnt getting that oily anymore. Loves that it is a foam cleanser too. FYI he is a blue collar worker so he be outside all day and he felt nice and fresh after using this.
